completed: POST /media/:id/view rejects current block, nonpublic post audience, private account, restricted creator, self and inactive/unpublished post cases before writing. Required gate read failures return unavailable.

Stable UUID eventId plus authenticated owner derives an existing rank_events primary key. Insert-returned row or exact duplicate lookup is required for stored=true. Failed writes reserve no process-local dedupe state. Conflicting payload under one identity returns409.

View session must match an existing same-owner/item/session watch_feed served row (event_type IS NULL). Generic rankEvents surface allow-list excludes watch_feed. Generic media batches now reject the four observed view event types.

Watch client generates UUID sessions; legacy non-UUID feed sessions are normalized to server UUIDs and returned for adoption. Served rows are awaited before the feed response; failed persistence is named in failedSources.
Feed analytics are named feed_served, distinct from observed impression. Seen-item and creator-fatigue reads use watch_impression only, excluding serves and playback outcome rows.

Watch player callbacks feed a bounded observation accumulator and owned transport under the existing MEDIA_RANKING_ENABLED flag. Pause/buffer/seek/background/preload and stale source callbacks do not accrue observed time. No polling, interval, disk queue or automatic retry was added.
Watch feed token acquisition and decoding are bound to the initiating observed owner; refreshed/superseded requests and unmounts abort; stale account or refresh replies do not update the active slot.
Media analytics batch awaits database-returned ids and reports accepted/discarded/failed separately. Actual immutable4031 trigger refusal is tested; no silent trigger rejection is reported as stored.
limitations: No deployment or hosted migration performed. Replit origin access remains denied; this patch is local reviewable code.
No physical-device or actual AV playback/visibility/accessibility performance proof. Jest exercises callbacks and native boundaries; it is not an iPhone build or device result.

PGlite executes the actual existing rank_events and4031 schema. Concurrent promise admission proves the primary-key constraint within that engine; it is not a new two-connection hosted/native lock test.
View receipts certify rank_events only. The secondary media_events side effect remains best effort and is not atomic with the rank event. No receipt claims both stores succeeded.
Idempotency lasts while the canonical rank_events receipt row remains retained. There is no new offline queue or automatic retry; network losses can undercount observations.
The existing completion measure requires at least10000ms observed playback in one loop. Shorter clips are not represented by this legacy completion metric. This patch does not redefine that policy.

Current audience is checked before view persistence, not transactionally locked with concurrent block/post-visibility changes. Platform consent policy and all-surface erasure/retention certification remain separate requirements.
loadMediaSignals still uses a row query subject to PostgREST response limits; this patch does not claim complete population aggregates or measured production latency.
The global mock guard currently reports two unrelated Input test mocks; no violation is in the Media-owned files.
